articles.title: Olivia Ponton's photo that sparked a frenzy among Joe Burrow's fans
articles.standfirst: As the Bengals prepare for a new NFL season, his partner took advantage of the final days before the return to competition to enjoy a vacation in Hawaii.
articles.summary: As the Bengals prepare for a new NFL season, his partner took advantage of the final days before the return to competition to enjoy a vacation in Hawaii.
articles.body:
"O livia Ponton is making the most of the last days of summer away from the NFL spotlight. The model traveled to Hawaii and decided to share part of the getaway with her followers through several photos. The influencer posted a reel from her vacation, and one of the images, in which she appears in a swimsuit, quickly became the center of the comments.

“I wish I could ‘Like’ it more than once”

The post, made on August 21, quickly began to accumulate comments and reactions from her followers. Among those who made themselves noticed was Livvy Dunne , former LSU gymnast and one of the most popular sports figures on social media, who responded to the photos with a message that quickly stood out among the replies: “I wish I could ‘Like’ it more than once”. The comment joined other reactions that started to appear shortly after Ponton shared the images from her getaway to Hawaii.

Sports Illustrated Swimsuit model Xandra Pohl also appeared, with a brief but forceful “Insane”. Ponton’s followers followed the same line and filled the post with praise. Several followers also joined in, praising Poton’s appearance.

The post came at a particular moment for the couple. After months of speculation, Burrow and Ponton were seen together during the Cincinnati Bengals' training camp, making much more evident the bond that had linked them since 2024.

From social media to the NFL

No wonder the images generated so much attention. Ponton built much of her popularity through TikTok and other social media before becoming a Sports Illustrated Swimsuit model in 2022.

But added to this is her relationship with the NFL star. The relationship between Joe Burrow and Olivia Ponton has come a long way since the first rumors. Now that both have been seen together publicly, any appearance by the model sparks special attention among the quarterback’s fans.

The scene began to change in 2026. Both were at the Kentucky Derby and later appeared together again, until reaching the moment of training camp that made their relationship much more visible.

The American model is once again in the spotlight, although this time without the need for Burrow to appear in the photograph. A getaway to Hawaii, an image in a swimsuit, and the reactions of her followers were enough for her name to start circulating strongly on social media again.

articles.title: Gia Duddy moves on from Will Levis with Bengals receiver Andrei Iosivas: The photo that appears to confirm the romance
articles.standfirst: The Instagram photos that have fans convinced Duddy has found a new NFL boyfriend
articles.summary: The Instagram photos that have fans convinced Duddy has found a new NFL boyfriend
articles.body:
Gia Duddy appears to have taken her latest relationship from subtle social media hints to something considerably more public, with Cincinnati Bengals wide receiver Andrei Iosivas now seemingly at the center of her romantic life.

The influencer recently shared Instagram Stories featuring two photo booth strips of herself and Iosivas. The images showed the pair posing together in several playful shots, although a white heart emoji was placed over Iosivas ’ face in one photo. Duddy was also pictured holding the strips, wearing a gold ring and delicate bracelet.

The photos carried branding from Photomatica and The Fox Bar & Cocktail Club, adding to the date-night feel of the post and giving followers another glimpse into what appeared to be an evening together.

Duddy appeared to document more of the night before sharing the couple photos. She posted images of a meal from Locust, including beef tartare served in a small red pot, rice topped with an egg yolk, capers and nori.

She also shared a picture of dessert, which featured a creamy dish topped with pink or red powder and coarse salt. A spoon was shown taking a bite, while Duddy gave the dessert an enthusiastic “10000/10” rating.

The posts come after several weeks of increasingly obvious clues that she may be dating the Bengals receiver.

Duddy’s latest posts fuel romance speculation

Earlier, Duddy shared a “day in my life” vlog that included a visit to Cincinnati’s Kettering Health Practice Fields. During the video, she said she was going to watch her boyfriend practice, before footage showed Iosivas wearing his No. 80 jersey and taking part in drills.

The post quickly caught the attention of followers, with several commenters suggesting they had figured out the identity of Duddy’s apparent new partner. She’d previously appeared to soft-launch the relationship through mirror selfies featuring a man dressed in white, although his face was hidden or cropped from the images.

Duddy’s renewed connection to the NFL has attracted attention because of her previous relationship with quarterback Will Levis . The pair met at Penn State in 2021 and dated for around three years before reportedly splitting in September 2023.

Duddy became widely recognized during Levis ’ rise to the NFL, particularly around his transition from college football to the professional game.

Iosivas , meanwhile, has established himself in Cincinnati since being selected by the Bengals in the sixth round, 206th overall, of the 2023 NFL Draft.

The 26-year-old Princeton product recorded 435 receiving yards and two touchdowns across 17 games last season, including nine starts. Through his first three NFL seasons, he’s recorded 84 receptions on 144 targets for 1,030 yards and 12 touchdowns.

Neither Duddy nor Iosivas has formally announced their relationship in the supplied posts. Still, the boyfriend reference and Duddy’s appearances around the Bengals have given fans plenty of reason to believe the two are now an item.

articles.title: Bengals rookie Landon Robinson wins the internet with epic Navy uniform arrival for NFL debut
articles.standfirst: He honored his Naval Academy background before ever taking a regular-season snap
articles.summary: He honored his Naval Academy background before ever taking a regular-season snap
articles.body:
L andon Robinson ’s first regular-season Sunday in the NFL didn't come with the kind of debut most rookies dream about.

The Cincinnati Bengals defensive lineman was inactive for the opener against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers , meaning there would be no first tackle, first sack or first snap to remember. He still found a way to make the day his own.

Robinson arrived at Paycor Stadium wearing his full Navy service uniform, a choice that immediately stood out amid the usual stream of designer outfits and carefully planned tunnel looks around the league. The reaction online was swift.

“Best pre-game outfit of all time,” one fan wrote. Another added: “Awesome. Congrats to this young man.” A third response captured why the moment resonated: “Now THIS is an entrance. You can buy a designer pregame fit. You cannot buy the story behind this one.”

Robinson’s road to Cincinnati was built at Navy

The gesture carried meaning because Robinson ’s path to the NFL was shaped by the United States Naval Academy. Cincinnati selected him with the 226th overall pick in the seventh round of the 2026 NFL Draft after he emerged as one of the most disruptive interior defenders in college football.

His senior season in 2025 brought American Athletic Conference Defensive Player of the Year honors and AP First-Team All-American recognition.

That résumé got him drafted, but nothing about a seventh-round pick’s roster spot is guaranteed. Robinson had to earn his place during camp and ultimately survived the cut to Cincinnati’s 53-man roster.

“I’m super excited to get started,” Robinson told the Akron Beacon Journal. “I think it’s the beginning of a long, long career, and I’m just excited to learn and grow.

“Obviously, you want to get out there as soon as you can, and you’re eager to go make plays, but it takes time in reality, especially as a younger player,” Robinson added.

First impression came before he ever played

Robinson ’s inactive status meant the uniform would be his biggest contribution to Week 1, but that doesn't diminish what the moment represented. He was entering the NFL without separating himself from the institution that helped get him there.

“You’ve got to learn and you’ve got to grow because it’s a big jump from college to the NFL,” Robinson said. “So, I’m excited to learn. I’m excited to grow.”

That opportunity should come. The Bengals kept Robinson because they believe he can develop into a useful part of their defensive line, and the NFL rarely allows depth players to remain spectators forever.

Injuries, rotation and performance eventually create chances. Robinson will have to wait for his. Until then, his first NFL game will still be remembered for an entrance that said far more about him than any expensive pregame outfit could have.

articles.title: Russell Wilson sparks Joe Burrow trade rumors ahead of Bengals' Week 1 kickoff: "I think he wants to leave"
articles.standfirst: The former NFL star says 2026 could become a breaking point if Cincinnati fails again
articles.summary: The former NFL star says 2026 could become a breaking point if Cincinnati fails again
articles.body:
Joe Burrow has spent most of his Cincinnati Bengals career carrying expectations that come with being one of the NFL’s elite quarterbacks. Russell Wilson believes those expectations could eventually turn into something more uncomfortable if the results don't follow.

Speaking on CBS ahead of Cincinnati’s Week 1 opener against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers , Wilson offered a striking prediction about Burrow’s future with the franchise.

“I think he's tired of losing,” Wilson said. “He's said that a few times. He's really focused on making sure that this is that special year.

“Listen, if it doesn't go well in Cincinnati this year, I'm just saying, I'm just telling you right now. I'm telling you right now, if it doesn't go well in Cincinnati this year, Joe Burrow's gone. I think he wants to leave.”

He added: “What's going to be interesting is, where does he go? There's some great teams that need a quarterback.”

Cincinnati hasn't reached the postseason since the 2022 season, while Burrow ’s career has repeatedly been interrupted by injury. He was limited to eight games last season because of a turf toe issue and has now played 10 or fewer games in three different years.

When healthy, though, Burrow remains one of the league’s best quarterbacks. That combination of elite play, repeated injuries and a prolonged playoff drought, creates obvious pressure on a Bengals team that has built its identity around him.

Burrow’s Week 1 start offered opposite message

If Burrow is frustrated, his play in the opener didn't suggest a quarterback mentally checking out. He completed 14 of 20 passes for 133 yards and a touchdown in the first half against Tampa Bay as Cincinnati built a 24-10 lead.

Wilson had actually praised that same mindset before delivering his trade prediction.

“I love Joe's mentality this offseason,” Wilson said. “His presence, and how focused he was and he just seems like he really wants to compete.”

That may ultimately be the more revealing part of the conversation. Burrow has made clear throughout his career that winning matters to him. What hasn't been established is that frustration would automatically lead to a trade demand.

Wilson believes 2026 could test that distinction. Cincinnati now has an entire season to prevent that conversation from becoming anything more than preseason speculation.
